items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I worked on the bill there with her.

ctx.x: Lee, didn't you play with Martha Ray a number of years ago at the Oriental Theater?

Yes, I remember Martha Ray in Chicago at the Oriental Theater there. I worked on the bill there with her. And I got a huge kick out of her with the way she would stretch her mouth and the way she would shake when she was going off the stage.
Well, I was going to ask some more about Mae West. If you remember, did she ever appear in New Orleans much or ever worked down here?
